name: ai.speko/mcp-calls
title: Speko — AI Calls for Devs
description: Place real, disclosed outbound phone calls to businesses straight from your coding agent.

environmentVariables.name: SPEKO_MCP_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Speko demo backing server (holds the keys + rails). Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8787.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_INTERNAL_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared secret sent as the x-internal-key header; must match the demo server's MCP_INTERNAL_KEY.
